title: Archenemy: Nicol Bolas: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.
"Arise. You have been anointed by the light. Go forth and fight without fear, for you shall be victorious."
He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.
The demon had flown past the reach of Erebos's whip but not the point of the sun god's spear.
His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.
Its wings disturb more than air.
"The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."
"Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."
"There is power in abandon, but far more in control." —Warden Hixus, to Kytheon
"In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."
"My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."
"Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."
"In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."
Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight." —Gideon Jura
A blazing sun that never sets.
Idealism fits him better than his armor.
"Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"
Progress comes at a price.
"I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."
"The best spot to hook one is right behind the gills." —Rana Cloudwake, kor skyfisher
"Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"
The void is without substance but cuts like steel.
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all." —Bishop Cawle of Elgaud
"The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."
As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.
The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.
Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."
It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.
"It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*
Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.
"Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."
He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.
The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.
Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.
Blood is holy to those whose god is War.
In the Skyfang Mountains, one misstep can mean the end of an entire clan.
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice." —Ryda, geomancer
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.
Its blood is life. Its body is growth.
To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.
"Show your enemies as much mercy as they would show you." —Surrak, the Hunt Caller
"When the land is angry, so are they." —Nissa Revane
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs." —Zurdi, goblin shortcutter
"Always carry two spears." —Mokgar, Kalonian hunter
"The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."
It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.
Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.
There is always a greater power.
In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.
If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.
Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.
Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.
The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living." —Olcot, Rider of Joffik
There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.
